patch_description: Key insight from prior runs: uniform random vertex perturbation wastes moves; the minimum triangle's vertices are the true bottleneck. This version keeps the adaptive-sigma strict-improvement hill climb (best performer at 0.67-0.71) but replaces uniform vertex selection with a bottleneck-weighted scheme: ~60% of moves perturb a vertex of the current smallest triangle, with a secondary "top-k bottleneck pool" (vertices in the 5 smallest triangles) for broader pressure. It also speeds up scoring with a vectorized hull (fewer Python-rounding steps) and divides the 3s budget into seed diversification + restarts around the best. Deterministic seed=42, strict improvement acceptance ensures monotone quality.
